title: No pricing doc teaches the old model: rewrite PRICING, VALUE-LADDER and PRICING-OPERATIONS, banner the history
detail: PHASE 7 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). docs/PRICING.md, VALUE-LADDER.md, PRICING-OPERATIONS.md rewritten; PRICING-LADDER-PLAN.md, design_handoff/BRIEF-03 and MARKETING-BRIEF bannered or updated; CORE-MODEL, FOCUS-MODEL, SPACES, SPACE-COLLABORATION-AND-SEATS and OFFER-MODEL fixed; Notion training DB updated per DOCS-PROTOCOL.
